title: Ann Obaseki
content:
Ann Obaseki Uwah (born 9 December) is a Nigerian media professional, film producer and entrepreneur. She is the Founder and CEO of Talentville Africa, Producer of comedic TV series "Visa on Arrival" and Managing Director of Lounge Network, the parent company of Lounge FM Lagos, Lounge FM Abuja, and Bside Radio Benin.


== Early life and career ==
Ann Obaseki is originally from Edo state but grew up with her parents - Grace and Jackson Obaseki in Lagos where she attended Sunnyfields Primary School and Anglican Girls Grammar School. She later went on to study Combined Arts at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, Nigeria.
In 2018, she launched Talentville with a vision to connect emerging artists in Nigeria with international opportunities.
